case_number: 2025 INSC 46; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 (@ SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CRL.) NO. 15651 OF 2024)
summary: Conviction under IPC s.307, s.148, s.149 set aside; upheld under s.326, s.325, s.452, s.323; plea for probation based on settlement in cross-case rejected; concurrent sentencing under s.428 Cr.P.C.; High Court's selective benefit to co-accused not grounds for interference; no compromise record in present case; conviction modified, not quashed.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed in part; conviction under s.307, s.148, s.149 set aside; conviction under s.326, s.325, s.452, s.323 upheld with modified sentence; benefit of probation denied; High Court order partially upheld.
